VizieR's original CPVS Table2 schema identifies ID as the ZTF name and Seq as the internal source identifier; Zenodo record 3886372 states SourceID joins the ztf2g/ztf2r attachments to Table2.
VizieR Table4's ID is a catalog-internal identifier, not a guaranteed Table2 Seq. Numeric ID-only comparison is not object-level proof.

evidence: Added explicit math.isfinite(snr) check before threshold comparison; full re-derivation reduced candidate count from 741787 to 741786.
Corrected CPVS Table2 identity mapping to read explicit Seq/SourceID; the full object-name crosswalk has zero missing published names and zero duplicate names.
Full source-backed membership result: 741786 candidates, 730184 published members, 730184 intersection, 11602 candidate-only, zero published-only; exact membership remains unresolved.
Full audit artifact preserves the complete 11602 SourceID/ZTF-name discrepancy ledger and input hashes.
Deterministic 100-object and 1000-object sample diagnostics with per-object g/r evidence and nonlinear SNR alternative are added but have not yet run against the full source artifact.

root_causes: Confirmed implementation defect: _snr_from_mag_error returned NaN for invalid errors, while the previous guard only checked snr < sigma; NaN comparisons are false, so invalid-error rows could qualify. The explicit finite-SNR guard removed one candidate.

Confirmed identifier-mapping defect: CPVS Table2's second field is Seq/internal SourceID, but the prior derivation and first crosswalk used one-based row ordinal. The resulting 16686/5083 crosswalk counts are invalid; the corrected explicit-Seq crosswalk is valid.

Full corrected comparison leaves 11602 candidate-only objects and zero published-only objects. The remaining membership discrepancy is not explained by the currently implemented linear SNR selection rule.
Table4's catalog-internal IDs are not treated as parent Seq values; published objects are mapped by ZTF name. No threshold or filter was weakened.

findings: Non-finite numeric results must be rejected explicitly before threshold comparisons.
CPVS Table2 Seq is the documented internal identifier joining the catalog to single-exposure photometry; row order is not a safe join key.
VizieR Table4's catalog-internal ID must not be assumed equal to Table2 Seq; use ZTF-name crosswalks.
Corrected full run verified 741786 candidates, 730184 published objects, 11602 candidate-only and zero published-only; zero false negatives does not explain the excess candidates.
Do not change SNR thresholds or acceptance criteria merely to force count equality.
